subject: Acme Corp POC - Next steps & success criteria
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: John Sweeney <john.sweeney@acmecorp.com>, Priya Rao <pri.rao@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Acme Corp POC - Next steps & success criteria

Hi John / Priya —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before kick-off: 

Summary of call:
- Goal: validate Redwood Inference for two production flows (search-ranking for product discovery, and FAQ/assist for the product docs)
- Duration: proposed 6-week POC (sandbox + pilot)
- Team: Acme product + data, Redwood SE + solutions (Rishi + Camila)

Proposed success criteria (draft):
- Latency: 95th percentile generation latency < 250ms for median queries (10k query sample)
- Cost: token cost <= $0.004 per 1k tokens (projected)
- Quality: intent-match >= 85% and rerank NDCG uplift >= 8% vs current baseline
- Integration: end-to-end flow working in staging with sample dataset and CI for a small subset of users

Immediate next steps:
1) I'll circulate the POC plan (attached) with milestones and owners — review and comment by next Tue (6/16)
2) Acme to share sample dataset (anonymized) + one sprint of queries and acceptance criteria
3) Rishi will spin up a sandbox and outline integration checklist
4) Schedule a kickoff 30–45 min technical sync the week of 6/22

Please confirm if the above looks right or flag anything missing. If you want to add a use case to the scope now is the time to call it out so we can include it in the baseline.

Attachments: redwood-poc-plan-v2.pdf (POC milestones, owners, telemetry requirements)

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0192

From: John Sweeney <john.sweeney@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priya Rao <pri.rao@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme Corp POC - Next steps & success criteria

Thanks Marissa — this looks good and I appreciate the clear milestones. A couple of asks from our side after talking to the product team: 

1) Can we add a third use case (customer support triage) to the scope? We want to validate how well Redwood handles intent classification + suggested responses when integrated with our Zendesk instance.
2) For success criteria, can we add a qualitative SLA: > 80% of suggested responses rated useful by CS agents in a blind review of 200 samples?

If adding the support triage use case requires more time, we’re ok extending the POC by ~2 weeks — please advise on impact to cost and timeline.

Also attaching the high-level evaluation criteria spreadsheet we use internally (will send the sample Zendesk export once sanitized).

Attachments: acmecorp-eval-criteria.xlsx

Best,
John
Sr. Product Manager | Acme Corp
john.sweeney@acmecorp.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: John Sweeney <john.sweeney@acmecorp.com>, Priya Rao <pri.rao@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Jun 2026 11:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme Corp POC - Next steps & success criteria

Hi John — thanks for the quick turn. Adding the support triage use case makes sense and is valuable for your org. Proposed rebaseline below so we can keep expectations aligned: 

Rebaseline proposal:
- Scope: Add "Support triage + suggested responses" as Use Case #3. Redwood will validate intent classification + response suggestion pipeline integrated with Zendesk sandbox.
- Timeline: Extend POC from 6 to 8 weeks (kickoff target 6/22, final review ~8/20)
- Success criteria (new items): 
  * Support triage: >= 80% usefulness in blind review of 200 agent-rated samples (as you requested)
  * Integration: Redwood connector pulls/sends to Zendesk staging with auth & sample tickets
- Impact: Estimated +2 weeks and a modest infra delta (+10% cost over initial estimate) — I'll get a formal estimate from Finance once you confirm scope.

Owner changes: Rishi will lead the integration and telemetry work; Camila will manage project coordination and reporting.

Next steps: 
- Priya / John: confirm sample data delivery date and preferred kickoff window (week of 6/22)
- Acme: provide sanitized Zendesk export + account sandbox credentials (read-only)
- Redwood: send updated POC plan + cost delta by 6/17

I’ve attached an updated POC plan with the added use case and revised timeline. Let me know if you want to call to review the rebaseline — happy to hop on 30 min.

Attachments: redwood-poc-plan-v2.pdf

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 10:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme Corp POC - Next steps & success criteria (internal notes)

Quick internal notes/ask before we confirm rebaseline to Acme: 

- For the support triage flow we should run two model variants: a smaller quantized model for classification and a larger L2/FP16 generator for suggested responses. Suggest we run A/B on latency/cost vs quality.
- Test data: need 2k tickets (sanitized) representing mixed categories and at least 200 labeled samples for blind review.
- Integration checklist: Zendesk OAuth token (read-only), sample webhook for agent actions, test account for sending suggestions.
- Telemetry: Rishi to add tracing for token-level latency and suggestion accept/decline signal to the POC dashboard.

Action items for Acme to confirm: provide Zendesk export and a point of contact for the CS team.

I’ll prepare infra estimate and a quick runbook for the integration by Mon 6/22.

-rishi
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Acme Corp POC - Next steps & success criteria (confirmed)

John / Priya — thanks for confirming and for the sample materials. Quick summary so we have the agreed rebaseline in writing: 

Agreed rebaseline:
- Scope: Use cases 1) product discovery ranking, 2) FAQ/assist, 3) support triage + suggested responses (Zendesk sandbox)
- Timeline: 8-week POC (kickoff technical sync week of 6/22, final review week of 8/17)
- Success criteria: previous items plus support triage usefulness >= 80% on 200 blind samples
- Owners: Marissa (project exec), Camila (project manager), Rishi (SE lead)
- Attachments: final POC plan and Acme evaluation criteria are saved in the shared Drive (link below)

Next steps:
1) Redwood to send updated project plan & cost delta (by 7/17)
2) Acme to provide sanitized Zendesk export + labeled samples (delivered 6/29)
3) Schedule kickoff for 6/22 — Camila to propose two slots next week

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-poc-acme
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567

We’ll treat this as the canonical rebaseline — if anything changes mid-POC we’ll capture it as a formal change request. Thanks everyone — excited to get started.

Best,
Marissa
